textTemplates.name: EOIAutoResponse
textTemplates.text:
Dear Agency Partner,

Thank you for submitting your Qantas Premium NDC Expression of Interest {!objNewCase.CaseNumber}.

It has been successfully received, and you can expect to hear back from the Qantas NDC Support Team within 14 business days.

Thank you,

Qantas NDC Support Team
Qantas Airways Limited

Please do not reply to this email. This is an unmonitored account.

textTemplates.name: NDC_portal_support_query_received_confirmation
textTemplates.text:
Dear Agency Partner,

Thank you for submitting your query {!objNewCase.CaseNumber}. It has been received by the Qantas NDC support team, and we will be in touch as soon as possible.

We aim to respond to all enquiries within 5 business days. If your booking departure date is within 3 business days, please contact your local Qantas Agency Connect team for assistance.

For all other servicing requests related to your Qantas NDC booking, please continue to follow normal processes. For further information, please see our Qantas NDC FAQs

Thank you,

Qantas NDC Support Team
Qantas Airways Limited

Please do not reply to this email. This is an unmonitored account.
 
Your original submission

{!objNewCase.Description}

textTemplates.name: NDC_portal_support_query_received_confirmation_esLA
textTemplates.text:
Estimada agencia asociada,

Gracias por enviar tu consulta {!objNewCase.CaseNumber}. Nuestro equipo de soporte de Qantas NDC la recibió correctamente y se comunicará contigo lo antes posible.

Intentamos responder a todas las consultas en un plazo de 1 a 2 días hábiles.

Si tu consulta está relacionada con la reserva de un cliente y el viaje se realizará dentro de un día hábil, ponte en contacto con el equipo de Qantas Agency Connect de tu país.

Gracias,

El equipo de soporte de Qantas NDC
Qantas Airways Limited

No respondas a este correo electrónico. Esta cuenta no está monitoreada.

textTemplates.name: NDC_portal_support_query_received_confirmation_frFR
textTemplates.text:
Chère agence partenaire,

Merci d'avoir soumis votre demande nº {!objNewCase.CaseNumber}. Elle a été reçue par l'équipe d'assistance de Qantas NDC et nous vous contacterons dès que possible.

Nous nous efforçons de répondre à toutes les demandes dans un délai de 1 à 2 jours ouvrables.

Si votre demande concerne la réservation d'un client et que le voyage a lieu dans un délai d'un jour ouvrable, veuillez contacter l'équipe Qantas Agency Connect de votre pays.

Merci,

L'équipe d'assistance de Qantas NDC
Qantas Airways Limited

Veuillez ne pas répondre à cet e-mail. Ce compte n’est pas surveillé.

textTemplates.name: NDC_portal_support_query_received_confirmation_itIT
textTemplates.text:
Gentile Agenzia partner,

Grazie per aver inviato la tua richiesta {!objNewCase.CaseNumber}. È stata ricevuta dal team di supporto Qantas NDC e ti contatteremo il prima possibile.

Ci impegniamo a rispondere a tutte le richieste entro 1-2 giorni lavorativi.

Se la tua richiesta riguarda la prenotazione di un cliente e il viaggio avverrà entro un giorno lavorativo, contatta il team Qantas Agency Connect del tuo Paese.

Grazie,

Team di supporto Qantas NDC
Qantas Airways Limited

Si prega di non rispondere a questa e-mail. Questo è un account non monitorato.

textTemplates.name: NDC_portal_support_query_received_confirmation_jaJP
textTemplates.text:
旅行代理店各位

お問い合わせ番号 {!objNewCase.CaseNumber} を送信いただきありがとうございます。お問い合わせは、カンタス航空NDCサポートチームが承りました。サポートチームよりできる限り速やかにご連絡いたします。

すべてのお問い合わせには、1～2営業日以内に回答するよう努めております。

お問い合わせ内容がご旅行予定のお客様の予約に関するもので、かつご旅行が1営業日以内の場合は、お住まいの国のQantas Agency Connectチームにご連絡ください。

よろしくお願いいたします。

カンタス航空NDCサポートチーム
Qantas Airways Limited

本メールには返信しないでください。自動配信メールアドレスから送信しています。

textTemplates.name: NDC_portal_support_query_received_confirmation_ptBR
textTemplates.text:
Cara agência parceira,

Obrigado por enviar sua consulta {!objNewCase.CaseNumber}. Esta foi recebida pela equipe de suporte do NDC Qantas e entraremos em contato o mais breve possível.

Nosso objetivo é responder a todas as perguntas em 1 ou 2 dias úteis.

Se sua dúvida estiver relacionada à reserva de um cliente e a viagem ocorrer dentro de um dia útil, entre em contato com a equipe do Qantas Agency Connect em seu país.

Obrigado,

Equipe de suporte do NDC Qantas
Qantas Airways Limited

Por favor, não responda a este e-mail. Esta é uma conta não monitorada.

textTemplates.name: NDC_portal_support_query_received_confirmation_zhCN
textTemplates.text:
尊敬的代理合作伙伴：

感谢你提交查询 {!objNewCase.CaseNumber}。澳洲航空 NDC 支持团队已收到此信息，我们将尽快与你联系。

我们力求在 1–2 个工作日内回复所有咨询。

如果你的查询涉及客户的预订，且其出行时间在一个工作日以内，请联系你所在国家的 Qantas Agency Connect 团队。

谢谢

澳洲航空 NDC 支持团队
澳洲航空有限责任公司

请勿直接回复此电子邮件。此邮箱无人查看。

textTemplates.name: NDC_portal_support_query_received_confirmation_zhHK
textTemplates.text:
尊敬的旅行社合作夥伴，

感謝你提交查詢 {!objNewCase.CaseNumber}。澳洲航空 NDC 支援團隊已收到此訊息，我們將盡快聯絡你。

我們致力在 1-2 個工作天內回覆所有查詢。

如果你的查詢與客戶預訂有關，並且在一個工作天內出發旅行，請聯絡你所在國家／地區的 Qantas Agency Connect 團隊。

謝謝！

澳洲航空 NDC 支援團隊
Qantas Airways Limited

請勿回覆本電郵。帳戶未經監控。

textTemplates.name: QDP_portal_support_query_received_confirmation
textTemplates.text:
Dear Agency Partner,

Thank you for submitting your query. It has been received by the Qantas Distribution Platform portal support team.

The support team will review your query and will be in touch within 1-2 business days.

If your query is related to a customer's booking and travel is within the next 24 hours, please contact the Qantas Agency Connect team in your country.

Please note, Qantas Distribution Platform portal support team operating hours are:
  • 9am to 5pm, Monday to Friday AEST excluding NSW public holidays.

Thank you,

Qantas Distribution Platform portal support team
Qantas Airways Limited

Please do not reply to this email. This is an unmonitored account.
